hero.headline: We build the digital infrastructure for agroecology.
hero.subheadline: Buffalo Back Labs provides the technology stack that helps grassroots collectives scale. From capturing offline farmer logs to powering seasonal subscription storefronts, we manage the complexity so you can manage the community.

problem.heading: Grassroots impact shouldn't die behind a desk.
problem.copy: Right now, agricultural software is built for auditors, forcing field workers to become data-entry clerks. We build "invisible" technology designed for the realities of agroecology—unpredictable yields, offline farms, and community-driven logistics.

ecosystem.fieldCopy: White-labeled, offline-first tools for farmers to log daily inputs using voice and local languages. Track organic transitions and automate compliance reporting without adding mental load to the farmers.
ecosystem.marketCopy: A subscription storefront built specifically for the physics of Community Supported Agriculture. Aggregate micro-yields from dozens of women farmers into weekly vegetable or flower subscriptions, with full traceability back to the grower.

pitch.heading: Built for Collectives, NGOs, and Federations.
pitch.copy: We sell the software. You run the logistics, manage the farmers, and keep the margins.

demo.title: Interactive Platform Preview
demo.subtitle: Explore how the BBL technology stack bridges the physical soil and digital commerce entirely on the frontend.

phone.option1Text: "Today, I harvested 2.5 kg of raw beans from bed 4."

phone.option2Text: "Applied 3 baskets of organic vermicompost to the field borders."
phone.option2Kn: "ಹೊಲದ ಅಂಚುಗಳಿಗೆ 3 ಬುಟ್ಟಿ ಸಾವಯವ ಎರೆಹುಳು ಗೊಬ್ಬರವನ್ನು ಹಾಕಿದ್ದೇನೆ."
